cases.rationale: A real person is airborne above a clearly identifiable skateboard, whose dark deck, rounded ends, trucks and wheels are visible at the lower right. The background is glass building frontage and pavement; the shirt lettering is printed decoration. No other defined object is identifiable in the whole crop, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The large bridled head and neck are an actual horse, and several actual people and human arms are visible around it. The ropes and bridle are not neckties or bags, and the foreground rail is not an identifiable bench. Flowering greenery behind the yellow barrier may be in containers, but the pot bodies are insufficiently resolved; potted plant is unclear. No other defined object is supported by visible evidence.

Three people prepare food at an eating table. A blade and handle are visible at the bread-cutting hands, supporting knife, and the foreground salad vessel has a curved bowl rim/body. Plates, leafy salad, tomatoes and bread do not establish the other food definitions. A partly obscured utensil near the plate lacks resolved tines, leaving fork unclear. The bread and greens on the central plate could form a sandwich, but filling between or supported by bread is not sufficiently resolved, so sandwich remains unclear. The circular wall decorations do not show an identifiable clock face.

Two actual people are visible on the snowy slope. The foreground rider has both boots bound to one broad snowboard, with its deck and binding clearly visible; this is not a skateboard or surfboard. Snow, rocks, fencing and slope markers supply no other defined object. There is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The foreground drinking vessel has a bowl, stem and foot, so it is a wine glass rather than a cup. A white open dip bowl and orange carrot sticks are visible beside celery and peppers. Behind them are topped pizzas with crusts, all arranged on an eating table. The basil-like leafy plant at upper right appears associated with a partly obscured container, but its pot cannot be identified confidently, so potted plant is unclear. The background wooden cylinder is a drum, not a category vessel or appliance.

An actual black bear with rounded ears, long muzzle and heavy body crosses the road. The lower-left vehicle side mirror and narrow adjoining body/window edge are real vehicle parts, but the crop does not resolve whether the vehicle is a passenger car or pickup/truck, so car and truck are unclear. The road signs are directional/warning signs, not stop signs or traffic lights. The forest vegetation has no pot context. No other defined object is identifiable.

An actual person walks beneath a transparent domed umbrella with visible ribs. Several passenger cars are parked along the street. A dark carried purse/handbag hangs at the person's right hip, partly cut by the lower-right edge. Street lamps and buildings do not establish traffic lights or any other defined object. The distant trees have no pots, and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The actual striped equid has a clearly identifiable zebra head, ears, torso, legs and tail. Its zebra identity excludes horse under the frozen definitions. The remainder is dry grass and unpotted woodland; no other defined object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

The left foreground is an actual washbasin/sink, with toiletry bottles showing bottle bodies and narrow necks/pumps beside it. A single-person metal-backed chair with a padded seat occupies the center. The broad-leaved plant at upper left has container context at the shelf, supporting potted plant. Towels, radiator, roof window and wire shelving do not establish other categories; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual washbasins have visible drain bowls and faucet assemblies. Pump soap bottles sit at the basin edges. The curved white toilet seat/bowl portion is visible along the bottom beneath the foreground sink/cistern structure, supporting toilet. The metal floor container is a wastebasket, not a drinking cup or bowl; tiles, plumbing and the mirror/frame supply no other defined objects. There is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Many actual pedestrians share the street with a clearly identifiable red double-decker bus and passenger cars at the left. A pedestrian near the center crossing has a dark pack worn on the back with shoulder-strap context, supporting backpack. Small pole-mounted signal-like heads around the crossing are too small/dark to identify their traffic-signal assemblies confidently, so traffic light is unclear. Decorative building lights and street lamps do not themselves qualify as signals. No other defined object is identifiable.

Two actual people walk across the foreground, with actual passenger cars on the street behind them. The left person's dark pack body and shoulder straps support backpack. The right person carries a brown handbag by its handles and a long rounded skateboard deck with grip-pattern surface. The board's carried street context and shape support skateboard rather than snowboard or surfboard. No other defined object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.
